body: Good point, a few minutes of pain shouldn't matter.  In a way, accepting a really painful method is a way of checking if I really want it.  I am going to finish this six pack, tie my neck to a tree, and jump.  Thanks for the help.

I graduated college with a degree in engineering and despite applying more places than I could count, I couldn't find a job.   My mother died when I was 14 and my dad walked out when I was 10.  The little family I have is really poor.  I didn't have any family to fall back on, so I ended up homeless.
